description: This file declares the interface for the Rte_Gpt module, including initialization, deinitialization, start/stop timer functions, and query functions for elapsed and remaining time, along with some configuration macros.

methods.name: Rte_Gpt_Init
methods.description: Initializes the GPT module, likely setting up hardware timers or internal state.

methods.name: Rte_Gpt_DeInit
methods.description: Deinitializes the GPT module, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Rte_Call_RP_Gpt_StartTicks
methods.description: Starts a timer with a specified number of ticks.

methods.name: Rte_Call_RP_Gpt_StartMs
methods.description: Starts a timer with a specified duration in milliseconds.

methods.name: Rte_Call_RP_Gpt_StartUs
methods.description: Starts a timer with a specified duration in microseconds.

methods.name: Rte_Call_RP_Gpt_Stop
methods.description: Stops the timer associated with the given logic channel.

methods.name: Rte_Call_RP_Gpt_GetElapsed
methods.description: Returns the elapsed time for the specified logic channel.

methods.name: Rte_Call_RP_Gpt_GetRemaining
methods.description: Returns the remaining time for the specified logic channel.
